book6ReadingRules: A civilization, state, city, enterprise, platform or network MUST NOT be forced into one global position.
Current dossiers MAY carry primary, secondary and unknown position correspondences by subsystem.

Capacity, load, alignment, resilience, adaptability, future capacity, external dependency, technology and population are reading dimensions and transition conditions; they are not the axes that create the 48 positions.
A position correspondence requires admitted evidence; missing current data remains UNKNOWN.
A transition is not established by one metric or one event; sustained multi-system relationship change and observation-threshold evidence are required.
